claim_scope: independent read-only verification of one gate-critical artifact and its counted coverage; worker evidence only, not a gate verdict, not a node status, not an adoption

target.why_unreviewed: landed 01:19:18, no independent review of it exists in reviews/ or comms/outbox at preregistration time; it is the artifact REC-39 names and the controller will read for G-FORM coverage

hypotheses.H1_pins_stable: the three schema pins and the FROZEN rev29 hash measured by the target artifact equal the live bytes at T0 and T1 of this run (0 drift)
hypotheses.H2_counted_accepts_bind: every accept counted in target.coverage_table[*].non_author_accepts_full resolves to a live review record whose verdict is accept, counts_as_full_schema_verdict is true, hard_failures is empty, and whose bound sha256 equals the target class pin
hypotheses.H3_non_author: no counted accept's reviewer equals the reviewed schema's authored_by/owner, the target's own author, or the FROZEN owner
hypotheses.H4_no_post_verdict_flip: no counted accept has a later verdict by the same reviewer at or after the accept that names the same pin and is revise/reject (a flip voids the count per CF-31 mutability)
hypotheses.H5_rec39_content: the target contains the REC-39 minimum content: for every verdict bound to a pin, a row with filename, reviewer, verdict, reviewed_sha256, verdict mtime, full-schema flag and independence basis; plus an explicit statement of which of the two divergent counts (controller scan vs lead per-file census) is correct and why the other is wrong

controls.K1_null: on live bytes the counted-accept extractor returns the target's counts and the verifier reports H2 as measured
controls.K2_hash_mutant: flipping one counted accept's bound sha256 in an in-memory sandbox copy must be flagged by the verifier
controls.K3_flag_mutant: setting counts_as_full_schema_verdict=false on one counted accept must be flagged
controls.K4_hard_mutant: setting hard_failures non-empty on one counted accept must be flagged
controls.K5_verdict_mutant: changing one counted accept's verdict to revise must be flagged
controls.K6_positive_revise: a known revise verdict at the same pin (worker-072's later F2b revise, named by worker-002) must not be returned as an accept
controls.K7_determinism: two consecutive runs over the same loaded snapshots produce an identical result digest
controls.K8_read_only: all eight pins re-measured after the run equal the T0 values; no write outside artifacts/worker-086/, runtime/state/ and comms/outbox/worker-086.jsonl

falsifier: Any of: (a) a counted accept in the target fails one of the H2 binding conditions at the live pin; (b) a counted accept's reviewer is an author of the reviewed schema or of the target; (c) a counted accept is self-superseded by its own reviewer's later revise naming the same pin; (d) a target-cited pin does not equal the measured live bytes; (e) a K2-K6 mutant escapes the verifier or K7 digests differ. H5 being measured as PARTIAL/ABSENT is a content finding, not a falsifier of this task.
next_falsifier: Re-run verify_r3_coverage.py after any byte move of the target, any review-file write under a fixed name, or any F1/F2a/F2b pin move; a fresh accept or revise at the same pin changes the census and voids this snapshot.
